title: 85 South: Ghetto Legends
overview: DC Young Fly, Karlous Miller and Chico Bean bring their famous podcast to the stage to create a unique comedy special where nothing and no one is safe from their jokes.

title: Chris Rock: Tamborine
overview: Chris Rock takes the stage for his first comedy special in 10 years, filled with searing observations on fatherhood, infidelity and American politics.

title: Chris Tucker: Live
overview: Comedian Chris Tucker performs live.

title: Dave Chappelle: Sticks & Stones
overview: Dave Chappelle takes on gun culture, the opioid crisis and the tidal wave of celebrity scandals in this defiant stand-up special.

title: Dave Chappelle: The Dreamer
overview: From his onstage tackle to the slap heard round the world, Dave Chappelle lets loose in this freewheeling and unfiltered stand-up comedy special.

title: Deon Cole: Charleen's Boy
overview: In an electric stand-up special, Deon Cole ponders romance, racist hotel showers, post-coital bedtime prayers and why he loves women of a certain age.

title: Deon Cole: Ok, Mister
overview: From the telltale signs of aging to bedroom mishaps and dating deal-breakers, Deon Cole spins comedy gold in this playfully candid special.

title: Katt Williams: The Last Report
overview: Back for his fourth Netflix stand-up special, comedy icon Katt Williams delivers his famously bold takes on conspiracies, celebrities and the world at large in this electrifying set.

title: Kevin Hart: What Now?
overview: Comedian Kevin Hart performs in front of a crowd of 50,000 people at Philadelphia's outdoor venue, Lincoln Financial Field.

title: Mike Epps: Delusional
overview: Follows comedian Mike Epps as he discusses how a little delusion and a lot of hustle made him a star.

title: Mo Gilligan: There's Mo to Life
overview: Mo Gilligan breaks down his days as a broke teenager, working in retail, relationship dynamics, annoying talk show producers and more in this special.

title: Sommore: Queen Chandelier
overview: This Queen of Comedy shines as she takes the stage to sound off on her suspicion of free stuff, social media prayer requests, fake lashes and ugly shoes.

title: Trevor Noah: Afraid of the Dark
overview: The 'Daily Show' host ponders the perils of naming countries, how traffic lights turn New Yorkers invincible and why you shouldn't drink in Scotland.

title: Trevor Noah: I Wish You Would
overview: Emmy-winning comedian Trevor Noah talks learning German, speaking ill of the dead, judging people in horror movies and ordering Indian food in Scotland.

title: Wanda Sykes: I'm an Entertainer
overview: The comedy icon sounds off on parenting with her French wife, the perils of public bathrooms and why she's tired of going high when others go low.

title: Kevin Hart: Zero F**ks Given
overview: Kevin Hart serves up laughs and brick oven pizza from the comfort of his home, and dishes on male group chats, sex after 40 and life with COVID-19.

title: Leslie Jones: Time Machine
overview: From trying to seduce Prince to battling sleep apnea, Leslie Jones traces her evolution as an adult in a joyfully raw and outrageous stand-up special.

title: Michael Che Matters
overview: "SNL" star Michael Che takes on hot-button topics like inequality, homophobia and gentrification in this stand-up set filmed live in Brooklyn.

title: Michelle Buteau: Welcome to Buteaupia
overview: Scene-stealing queen Michelle Buteau dazzles with real talk on relationships, parenthood, cultural differences and the government workers who adore her.

title: Nicole Byer: BBW (Big Beautiful Weirdo)
overview: Nicole takes the stage at the Gramercy Theatre for a HOT new set, discussing everything from how she basically is a vegan (she's just doing her part), what she's looking for in a man, and just how crazy this past year-and-a-half has been.

title: Michelle Buteau: A Buteau-ful Mind at Radio City Music Hall
overview: Michelle Buteau talks going viral, raising twins, and the lows of getting high in this herstory-making special.

title: Tig
overview: An intimate documentary that follows Tig Notaro, a Los Angeles based comedian, who just days after being diagnosed with invasive stage II breast cancer changed the course of her career with a poignant stand-up set that became legendary overnight. It explores Tig's extraordinary journey as her career ignites and as her life unfolds in grand and unexpected ways, all the while continuing to battle a life-threatening illness and falling in love.

title: Your Friend, Nate Bargatze
overview: In his third Netflix special, Nate Bargatze tackles pizza-ordering strategies for guys' night, wanting a second dog and relying on his responsible wife.

title: Taylor Tomlinson: Have It All
overview: Can Taylor Tomlinson have it all? From dating woes to dream jobs to inventive dirty talk, she shares life's ups and downs in this stand-up comedy special.

title: Jordan Jensen: Take Me with You
overview: In her hilarious debut special, Jordan Jensen delivers unapologetic takes on failing at femininity, the paradox that is “self love” and the horrors of trying to find it.

title: Iliza Shlesinger: Hot Forever
overview: Iliza Shlesinger talks about different topics. She starts from every girl's ugly bra to how all adult men need to own a box spring.

title: Jeff Dunham: Beside Himself
overview: The ventriloquist, Jeff Dunham, taped his second Netflix special in his hometown of Dallas, TX in the American Airlines Center. He returns with his normal cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, José Jalapeño on a Stick, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, and one of his newest additions Larry, a high strung, chain-smoking, on-again, off-again personal adviser to the President.

title: Christina P: Mom Genes
overview: Comedian Christina P examines the joys and drags of parenting, partnering and more through a no-nonsense Gen-X lens in this special.

title: Jamie Foxx: What Had Happened Was...
overview: Oscar- and Golden Globe-winning actor. Grammy-winning singer. Beloved comedian. Jamie Foxx returns to the stage to set the record straight.

title: Chelsea Handler: Revolution
overview: Chelsea Handler lets loose on her life choices, rowdy rescue dogs, dating frustrations, and why society owes women an apology.

title: Andrew Schulz: LIFE
overview: In this razor-sharp yet heartfelt special, Andrew Schulz unpacks the wildest moment of his life — becoming a father.

title: Ali Wong: Don Wong
overview: In her third Netflix stand-up special, Ali Wong reveals her wildest fantasies, the challenges of monogamy and how she really feels about single people.

title: The Honeymoon Stand Up Special
overview: Impending parenthood does funny things to Natasha Leggero and Moshe Kasher, who dissect family, relationships and more in a trio of stand-up specials.

title: Rachel Bloom: Death, Let Me Do My Special
overview: Comedian and actor Rachel Bloom muses on birth, death, cosmic uncertainty and pungent trees in this whimsical and reflective musical comedy special.

title: Daniel Sloss: Live Shows
overview: Comedian Daniel Sloss is ready to find the funny in some very dark topics, from the deeply personal to the truly irreverent.

title: Panayotis Pascot: Almost
overview: Those who still see him as an innocent teen TV correspondent are in for a surprise: French comic Panayotis Pascot is all grown up and ready to get real.

title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Fedi Nuril
overview: Actor Fedi Nuril takes the hot seat as he faces hilarious jokes from a panel of six comedians and celebrities through the “Trilogy of Laughter”.

title: Neal Brennan: Blocks
overview: From the weird relationship humans have with dogs to how dating a model is like owning a dune buggy, Neal Brennan muses on his life in this stand-up special.

title: Oh, Hello on Broadway
overview: Two delusional geriatrics reveal curious pasts, share a love of tuna and welcome a surprise guest in this filming of the popular Broadway comedy show.

title: Mike Birbiglia: The Old Man and the Pool
overview: Comedian Mike Birbiglia dives headlong into mortality, medical tests, nature's pillows and an overchlorinated YMCA pool in this candid one-man show.

title: My Next Guest with David Letterman and Shah Rukh Khan
overview: "King of Bollywood" Shah Rukh Khan opens up about his rise to fame, his family and his billions of fans as he and Dave meet up in Mumbai and New York.

title: Mike Birbiglia: The Good Life
overview: Drugs. Marriage. Kids' parties. Mike Birbiglia reevaluates life as a son — and as a father — in this hilarious and deeply personal comedy special.

title: My Next Guest Needs No Introduction with David Letterman
overview: Late-night TV legend David Letterman hosts an intimate talk show featuring insightful conversations and fun-filled excursions with notable figures.

title: John Mulaney: Baby J
overview: A chaotic intervention. An action-packed stay in rehab. After a weird couple of years, John Mulaney comes out swinging in his return to the stage.

title: Deaw Still Alive
overview: Comedian Udom Taephanich shares candid stories from his chaotic life, from superstition and dark rituals to his time in Korea.
